items.title: Correct requirements NAV decision-document count
items.context: Codex CLI and Claude CLI audits found docs/requirements/NAV.md declares 37 files while decisions currently has 38 markdown files and 38 NAV decision links. Fix the count only.
items.userSees: User sees docs/requirements/NAV.md declare 38 decision files, matching the 38 linked decision docs in docs/requirements/decisions.

happy.desc: NAV declared decision-file count equals the number of decision markdown files and decision links after the edit.

edge.desc: The count correction does not leave missing or stale decision links in NAV.

adversarial.desc: The edit does not reorder, regenerate, or rewrite unrelated NAV entries.
